items.资讯标题: Turning Database Grading into RL Rewards: Post-Training Agents with ThinkingBox
items.desc: ThinkingBox-Bench contains 507 tasks, each starting a real backend, providing the agent with MCP tools and a simulated LLM user with private context, and running executable checks against the terminal database state. ThinkingBox, ThinkingBox-Bench, and ThinkingBox-Training were built by the Microsoft Copilot Studio team in partnership with Toloka, with collaborators from the University of Pittsburgh, Northwestern University, Columbia University, and UC Irvine who interned at Microsoft.

items.资讯标题: 特斯拉 AI 豪赌遇阻：2026 支出砍 20%，马斯克转型节奏生变
items.desc: 特斯拉三季度资本支出47.3亿美元，同比翻倍以上，但环比少约10亿美元，远低于分析师预期的79.5亿美元。公司同时将2026年资本支出目标从逾250亿美元下调至约200亿美元，降幅近20%。不过，当季自由现金流约15.3亿美元，明显好于市场预期的负值，短期财务表现反而改善。
